mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_category (code, name, parent_id, pricing_path, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{pricingPath}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_category WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM product_category WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM product_category WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM product_category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM product_category WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM product_category WHERE code = #{code} AND id != #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
